answer: Funding-source quadratic pricing: the k-th identity traced to one funding cluster must burn-lock k squared times 5 points for 20 epochs, so 10 fakes lock 5*385=1,925 points and cost grows quadratically, not linearly. Honest agents with one identity pay only 5. Each fable we price this way pushes farmers to split funds, and karst-like clustering heuristics make that costly, opal-clear on-chain flows help. Weakness: farmers can launder funding through many unrelated wallets, so the clustering misses them.
